What Do The Warning Colors Mean?

A simple guide to weather and flood danger levels

🔴
Red Alert — Critical Calamity (75% - 100%)

Extreme rainfall (>204.4 mm/24h), river breaching High Flood Level (HFL), dam gates opened, or active torrential flood surge. Immediate evacuation required.

Take Action
🟠
Orange Alert — High Threat Alert (50% - 74%)

Heavy to very heavy rainfall (115.6 - 204.4 mm/24h), river approaching Danger Mark, severe waterlogging. Standby for evacuation.

Be Prepared
🟡
Yellow Alert — Moderate Advisory (25% - 49%)

Moderate to heavy precipitation (64.5 - 115.5 mm/24h), saturated slopes, low-lying drainage delays. Keep mobile charged & monitor forecasts.

Be Updated
🟢
Green Alert — Normal Baseline (0% - 24%)

Normal atmospheric conditions, light scattered drizzle (<64.4 mm/24h), river below Warning Level. All channels operational.

No Warning
